Syllabus & Passing Threshold / Marks for the Written Test
The aptitude test will consist of three parts (i) English Section (35%), (i) Mathematics
Section (35%), and (iii) Specialized Section (30%). English section will contain
comprehension, grammar, composition, and vocabulary. Mathematics section will test
the knowledge of fundamental mathematics and will be in line with curriculum of
SAT/GMAT, and Specialized section will contain the topics related to the subject
positions. There will be no negative marking in the test. Aptitude Test will be held in
Karachi only. Overall, 60% marks are required to pass the test and call for the group
discussion. Candidates who under perform in the aptitude test and do not meet SHD
prescribed criteria will not be called for Group Discussion. Similar guidelines will be
followed for evaluating Group Discussion.
